settings.title: The PostgreSQL database the engine runs on
The model file installed on a database's first start; not the active model
Signs pagination cursors; unset, each process makes its own, so cursors stop working after a restart and differ between instances
Browser origins allowed to call the API

Where the API reference page at /docs/api loads its script from: bundled or cdn
Server worker processes on this instance
Database connections each process keeps open
Database connections each process opens beyond the pool size when busy
Seconds a request waits for a database connection before it answers 503
Seconds a connection may sit idle inside a transaction before the database ends it, releasing a stalled process's locks; 0 turns it off
How the log is written: text lines, or one JSON object a line
The lowest level the log writes
Seconds between each process's reports of its state to the others

Items in one consumer batch resolve

The proposal provider: claude, openai-compatible or a factory module:function; empty, the default, sends nothing anywhere
The provider's model; empty for claude means claude-opus-5-5
The provider's key; never shown
The provider's address: required for openai-compatible, empty for Claude's own
The most that may leave the instance: structure (no values), samples (a few) or values (as many as a feature needs)
At send level samples, the most values per column, or rows per sheet, that are sent
The confidence, 0 to 1, below which a proposal is not offered
Keep each call's request and answer for an operator debugging a prompt
Days a call's kept request and answer stay, when AI_LOG_CONTENT is on

openai-compatible only: how much the model reasons first, none, low, medium or high; empty sends nothing. none keeps a local thinking model fast
The model's context window in tokens, for a small local model; each call is sized to half of it. Empty: no limit
Days an assistant task is kept after it finished (loaded, failed or cancelled) or was last changed; then it and its file are deleted
The command that starts the assistant's Claude Code session, for example: claude --model sonnet; empty, the assistant runs no session
container when the engine runs in a container, where Claude Code's own sandbox cannot run; empty, the operating system's sandbox
The API address the assistant's session uses; empty, this instance's own
Whether assistants can reach the instance at /mcp; off, the endpoint does not exist

Whether an assistant may register itself; off, only those an administrator registers can sign people in
HTTPS hosts a self-registered assistant may return to, besides this computer
Days a record of a tool call through /mcp is kept
The longest answer of a tool through /mcp; past it a page comes back smaller, with a cursor
